_meta.indication: Temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines associated with corrugator and/or procerus muscle activity in adult patients

pivotal_trials.phase: Phase 3 pivotal efficacy trial (randomized, multi-center, double-blind, placebo-controlled)
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized 3:1 to a single treatment with JEUVEAU (20 Units total, 4 Units at five sites) or placebo
pivotal_trials.population: Healthy adults (ages 18 to 81) with glabellar lines of at least moderate severity at maximum frown
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects achieving ≥2-grade improvement from baseline at maximum frown at Day 30, assessed independently by both investigator and subject on the Glabellar Line Scale
pivotal_trials.n: EV-001: N=246 JEUVEAU, N=84 placebo (both trials combined enrolled 654 subjects)
pivotal_trials.result: EV-001 responder rate: 67% JEUVEAU vs 1% placebo at Day 30

pivotal_trials.phase: Phase 3 pivotal efficacy trial (randomized, multi-center, double-blind, placebo-controlled)
pivotal_trials.design: Identical design to EV-001; randomized 3:1 to single treatment with JEUVEAU 20 Units total or placebo
pivotal_trials.population: Healthy adults (ages 18 to 81) with glabellar lines of at least moderate severity at maximum frown
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects achieving ≥2-grade improvement from baseline at maximum frown at Day 30 on the Glabellar Line Scale (investigator and subject)
pivotal_trials.result: EV-002 responder rate: 71% JEUVEAU vs 1% placebo at Day 30

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions: headache (9.3%), eyelid ptosis (2%), upper respiratory tract infection (3%), and increased white blood cell count (1%). Boxed warning for distant spread of toxin effect, including life-threatening swallowing and breathing difficulties.
target_moa: Acetylcholine release inhibitor and neuromuscular blocking agent; blocks neuromuscular transmission by binding to motor nerve terminals and cleaving SNAP-25, inhibiting acetylcholine release and producing localized chemical denervation of muscle
modality: Other – botulinum toxin type A (900 kDa protein produced from fermentation of Clostridium botulinum)

boxed_warning.content: Distant spread of toxin effect: effects may spread from the injection area to produce botulinum toxin symptoms; swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have been reports of death

summary.text: JEUVEAU (BLA 761085) was a Standard review BLA under section 351(a) with no expedited designations. It was not a first-cycle approval: FDA issued a Complete Response letter dated 15-MAY-2018 for product-quality/CMC deficiencies, and the drug was approved after Evolus's resubmission received August 2, 2018. The application was not referred to an advisory committee, carries two postmarketing commitments, and no REMS.

citations.quote:
Priority or Standard	Standard
Submit Date(s)	12-MAY-2017

This application is a resubmission of the BLA in response to the Agency's Complete Response (CR) letter dated 15-MAY-2018 for JEUVEAU (prabotulinumtoxin A), designated DWP-450, manufactured by Daewoong Pharmaceuticals (Evolus Inc.) for the treatment of temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines associated with corrugator and/or procerus muscle activity in adults.
We acknowledge receipt of your resubmission dated August 2, 2018, which constituted a complete response to our May 15, 2018, action letter.

Your application for JEUVEAU was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

basis.text: Product quality / CMC deficiencies: the submitted data were not sufficient to conclude that manufacture of JEUVEAU is well-controlled and would yield a product that is safe, pure and potent for the duration of the shelf-life

citations.quote: The data submitted in this application are not sufficient to support a conclusion that the manufacture of JEUVEAU is well-controlled and will lead to a product that is safe, pure and potent for the duration of the shelf-life. From a CMC standpoint, OPQ recommends a Complete Response letter be issued to Evolus, Inc. to outline the deficiencies noted below and the information and data that will be required to support approval.
